packageRules.description: The Vite+ toolchain moves as one (ADR 6), so both catalog entries go together
A pnpm bump can change what the install policy in pnpm-workspace.yaml means, so it never automerges and its body says to read the migration notes (docs/standards/dependencies.md)
prBodyNotes: Read pnpm's migration notes for `minimumReleaseAge` and `trustPolicy` before merging: this bump can change what those settings mean.
